hints.title: Parity and Balance Prerequisites
hints.text: The total path length is m + n - 1. A valid parentheses string must have even length, start with '(', and end with ')'.

hints.title: Prefix Balance Tracking
hints.text: At each cell (r, c), maintain the set of achievable open parentheses balances.

hints.title: Pruning Negative and Excessive Balances
hints.text: The balance cannot drop below 0 or exceed the remaining steps available to reach the destination.

hints.title: Grid State Transition Implementation

complexity.notes: Max balance at any cell is bounded by (m + n) // 2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all paths independently incurs 2^(m + n) exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set of achievable balance values per grid cell.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate observes length parity and prunes paths whenever balance becomes negative.
